alt: Fertilisation in three steps (OpenStax) - sperm break through the corona radiata to reach the zona pellucida; contact with the zona triggers the acrosome reaction, releasing enzymes that digest it; a single sperm reaches and fuses with the oocyte plasma membrane. Labels: acrosome, sperm nucleus, oocyte cytoplasm, plasma membrane, sperm receptors, zona pellucida, corona radiata.
